configuration.cache_policy: direct-mapped tile_index modulo cache_tiles; reset before each workload

semantics.missing_policy: Either missing source makes all eight features missing
semantics.derived_storage: native-endian int64 within this process; codec is lossless on those bytes

protocol.construction_includes: allocation, feature computation or recipe setup; compressed blocks also encode
protocol.queries_include: tile lookup or direct scalar calculation, computation/decompression, checksum consumption
protocol.excluded: input I/O, schedule generation, streamed oracle, per-value codec validation, JSON output; no source edits
protocol.memory_accounting: actual vector capacities plus C++ objects and schedule; excludes allocator bookkeeping, executable, libraries and report bookkeeping
protocol.construction_peak_note: accounted retained bytes plus maximum extra encoded scratch; not measured RSS
protocol.rss_note: process lifetime high-water; use --only-method in fresh processes for method attribution
protocol.checksum_note: unsigned 64-bit modular sum of mixed value/row/feature terms; compressed payloads also checked per-value
